title: PosterHarness: Turning Scientific Poster Generation into an Auditable Instruction-Following Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2607.03006v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-rich image models can now design poster-scale layouts, but we lack ways to measure whether they honor scientific communication contracts: legible labels, prescribed aspect ratios, and -- above all -- abstaining from fabricated scientific figures. We present POSTERHARNESS, an auditable harness reframing poster generation as measurable instruction-following tasks, with a pilot benchmark and failure taxonomy. POSTERHARNESS uses a placeholder-first contract to separate two jobs models otherwise conflate. The model performs visual-summary design: typography, reading path, color, and background -- but never draws data-bearing figures. Every figure region must be an empty labeled placeholder; a deterministic compositor inserts real source-paper figures at detected coordinates. This makes properties measurable: placeholder count and ID accuracy, blankness, aspect-ratio compliance, abstention from synthesized graphics, public-text

translated_title: PosterHarness：将科学海报生成转变为可审计的指令遵循基准
translated_abstract: 丰富文本的图像模型如今已能设计海报规模的版面，但我们缺乏衡量它们是否遵守科学传播契约的方法：清晰可读的标签、规定的宽高比，以及——最重要的是——避免伪造科学图表。我们提出了POSTERHARNESS，这是一个可审计的评测框架，将海报生成重新定义为可度量的指令遵循任务，并附带一个试点基准和失败分类法。POSTERHARNESS采用“占位符优先”契约来分离模型通常混淆的两项任务：模型只执行视觉摘要设计——排版、阅读路径、配色和背景——但绝不绘制承载数据的图表。每个图表区域必须是带标签的空白占位符；由确定性合成器在检测到的坐标处插入真实的源论文图表。这使得各项属性可被度量：占位符数量与ID准确性、空白性、宽高比合规性、对合成图形的拒绝，以及公共文本……
tldr: 该论文提出POSTERHARNESS，一个可审计的基准框架，通过“占位符优先”契约将科学海报生成转化为可度量的指令遵循任务，要求模型只负责视觉设计而绝不伪造数据图表，从而能够客观检测占位符准确性、宽高比合规性与拒绝合成图形等关键属性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents POSTERHARNESS, an auditable benchmark that reframes scientific poster generation as measurable instruction-following tasks via a placeholder-first contract, requiring models to perform only visual design while abstaining from fabricated data figures, enabling objective measurement of placeholder accuracy, aspect-ratio compliance, and abstention from synthesized graphics.
